ingress.description: Name of the ingress resource (in the same scope) this app is served from. The app inherits the ingress's provider (its compute host's); it declares no provider of its own.

subdomain.description: Public subdomain the app is served on. The fully-qualified domain is composed at realization from the scope and base domain.

spa.description: When true, any path that does not map to a file serves index.html (single-page-app deep-link fallback).
